reviews.comment: Thanks to Nadeem and Prime Skills, I passed my driving test on my first attempt. The whole learning experience was an absolute pleasure and I thoroughly enjoyed every lesson. While at first, I was very tense and nervous, Nadeem always kept calm and helped me to relax, partly by being so fun to talk to. It's so clear that he genuinely cares about his students and the feedback that he offers has always been very specific to me as a driver. He's extremely insightful and was able to identify the aspects of my body language that showed what was psychologically holding me back. Over time, with his guidance I was therefore able to build a great deal of confidence and pass my test without even feeling nervous. Nadeem would always carefully listen to any concerns I had and notice areas I was struggling with so that he could then spend a lesson focusing on that skill (for example, when I wanted to ensure I was checking my mirrors at the right times). I am hugely appreciative of Nadeem for being so patient and always making me feel so safe during my lessons. I would therefore definitely recommend him to any learner drivers! Thank you Nadeem.
